---
title: "Simple Linear Regression"
Author: "Dominick Ferreira"
format: html
---

```{r}
source("data_cleaned.R")

slr_model <- lm(interest_rate ~ income, pima_hmda_clean)

summary(slr_model)

ggplot(pima_hmda_clean, aes(x = income, y = interest_rate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)+
  labs(
    x="Applicant Income in thousands, USD",
    y="Interest rate (%)"
    )

```
